newsitem.title: FINLAND: Cultor sells firm to Orkla unit.
newsitem.headline: Cultor sells firm to Orkla unit.

text.p: Finnish food group Cultor Oy said on Friday it had sold its silage preservatives unit to Norwegian-Swedish Denofa AS.
The price of the deal was not given.
"Cultor's Suomen Rehu Oy has sold its silage preservative operations to Denofa AS owned by Norwegian-Swedish Orkla ASA ," Cultor said in a statement.
"The transaction was a natural continuation to the sales of the Finnish silage preservatives business, which Suomen Rehu carried out in December 1996," it added.
Cultor sold its Finnish silage preservatives operations to Kemira's chemicals unit in December last year.
